title: Understanding Addition Reactions
text: In addition reactions, atoms or groups are added to a molecule without any atoms being removed. The double bond (C=C) becomes a single bond (C-C) as atoms add on.

title: Alkene Reactivity
text: Alkenes are unsaturated (contain C=C double bonds). The pi bond in the double bond is relatively weak and breaks easily, allowing new atoms to add.

title: Halogenation
text: When a halogen (F$$_2$$, Cl$$_2$$, Br$$_2$$, I$$_2$$) adds across a double bond, it is called halogenation - a specific type of addition reaction.
